verdict.rationale: Canny's own Autopilot feature automatically captures feedback in the background from support, sales, and call-transcript sources, and native integrations sync statuses with tools like Jira and Linear. That is product-native autonomous automation, but it is a fixed capture and sync pipeline rather than general user-configurable automations. The "run agents" claim depends on external LLM agents connecting through MCP, which is a building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: user-defined automation rules or triggers, scheduling or recurring-job configuration, documentation of how Autopilot is set up and controlled, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
